verdict.summary: The change is coherent and honestly scoped. The boolean builder reuses the existing u64 relation with hooks 0/1, pins the public xsd:boolean datatype constant, derives rather than accepts the expected verdict, and rejects unsupported lexical/datatype inputs. The tests cover the complete truth table, host/member leaf rebinding, both datatype-lane separation directions, dispatch legality, serialization/TOML layout, and real witness acceptance/rejection when nargo is available; the new feature-matrix leg ensures the feature-gated suite is exercised in CI. Public API documentation is updated and repeatedly preserves the INV-VL, CR-G8/sq-qhy4, and external-audit caveats. No actionable correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect was found. Local execution was unavailable because cargo is not installed in this review environment.
